newsitem.title: USA: MGM's Kerkorian in talks to buy Metromedia - report.
newsitem.headline: MGM's Kerkorian in talks to buy Metromedia - report.

text.p: Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer Inc (MGM) co-owner Kirk Kerkorian is in serious talks with billionaire John Kluge to acquire Kluge's Metromedia Entertainment Group, which includes Orion Pictures and the Samuel Goldwyn Co, Daily Variety said on Monday.
The report, which cited sources close to both companies, said details of Kerkorian's offer were unknown, but Kluge was known to be asking as much as $650 million.
MGM was not immediately available. Both MGM and Metromedia Entertainment were quoted by Daily Variety as declining to comment.
It was not clear if Kerkorian was acting alone or with the involvement of Kerry Stokes' Seven Network, his 50 percent partner in the studio they bought last summer for $1.3 billion, the report said.
